notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Allies.
description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
